description: Dispatch inside the IDE: Cmd+K edits, Tab completion, agent changes, checkpoints, codebase search.
cmd.toggleTab: Turn Tab Completion On or Off
cmd.acceptAllHunks: Accept All Agent Changes in File
cmd.undoAllHunks: Undo All Agent Changes in File
cfg.commandLocation: Where the dispatch command is, for people who run their own copy. Leave empty to use the one that comes with Dispatch.
cfg.keepAwake: While the Agents window is open: system keeps this Mac from going to sleep (the screen still dims and locks), display keeps the screen on too, off leaves it to the Mac's energy settings.
cfg.tabDelay: How long to wait after you stop typing before a Tab suggestion is asked for, in milliseconds.
